flaw: The primary estimand, task and success claim remain broader than the feasible design.
why_it_matters: The headline promises improvement beyond both persistence and composition-only across forecasting, while the named primary contrast supports only combined versus composition-only in one interpolation proxy. Flexible task/horizon choice permits a favorable result to stand for an untested direction.
evidence: SYNTHESIS_0 Proposed hypothesis/Evaluation; EXPERIMENT_DESIGN Minimal primary question and Statistical analysis; debate/benchdesign explicitly chooses T2 embryo E7.25 from E6.75/E8.0 and persistence secondary. T1/T3 coverage limitations are correctly admitted.
required_fix: Adopt one provisional primary: T2 embryo released-stage interpolation, E6.75/E8.0 training and E7.25 assessment; name conditional-state benefit over composition-only as the confirmatory claim. Mark persistence and other tasks secondary/exploratory. State that the proxy does not establish official interpolation, extrapolation or unseen-gene performance. Freeze exact manifest-dependent assessment before access.
verification: Revised synthesis and design agree on one task, horizon, contrast and permissible headline; a preregistration template records panel, scorer and embryo weighting without fabricating available replication.
residual_risk: A single proxy stage can remain unrepresentative; stage and embryo can be confounded even after this correction.

flaw: Practical margins and joint decision logic are absent, and the sample-size formula targets the wrong distance for the stated success threshold.
why_it_matters: A positive effect or nonsignificant harm cannot establish meaningful benefit with no degradation. Testing mean D above δ* requires planning at μ_A−δ*, rather than treating δ* as the detectable effect; current formula can understate required replication.
evidence: EXPERIMENT_DESIGN uses n≈[(z_(1−α/2)+z_(1−β))σ/δ*]^2 and rejects benefit if the effect fails a practical margin. debate/stats and debate/benchdesign already supply the corrected one-sided alternative and guardrail upper-bound logic.
required_fix: Specify D=MMD(comp,target)−MMD(combined,target), one-sided lower bound above δ*, separate anticipated μ_A>δ*, and planning denominator μ_A−δ*. Define deterioration-oriented G_j with simultaneous upper bounds below η_j, or explicitly make secondary components descriptive and drop the no-degradation claim. Leave numerical values unassigned until eligible pilot/scientific tolerances exist.
verification: Formula, null, alternative and success decision are algebraically consistent; a symbolic worked case demonstrates that μ_A approaching δ* increases required n. State descriptive-only analysis if independent n is insufficient.
residual_risk: Pilot variance and margins can be poorly estimated; litter clustering and small sample coverage remain unresolved without manifests.

flaw: Residual-guided architecture escalation is not separated operationally from final assessment.
why_it_matters: Choosing VAE/OT/flow/ODE/GNN after inspecting the E7.25 residual makes that target development data. Equal budgets and train-only preprocessing do not restore independent assessment. Three snapshots offer no natural nested stage split for a two-stage fitted trend.
evidence: SYNTHESIS_0 says escalate if simpler models leave a relevant residual. EXPERIMENT_DESIGN permits conditional complex candidates, admits nested tuning may be impossible, but has no irrevocable selection/assessment ledger. Actual agent_orchestrator.py _proxy_score scores already-built candidates rather than retraining exclusions.
required_fix: Freeze the minimal estimator and hyperparameters using training evidence or separately eligible development data before assessment. Allow target residual analysis only as exploratory follow-up; subsequent model assessment requires a fresh eligible target. Record each target access and model choice. Explicitly forbid original proxy scoring as the implementation of this plan.
verification: A decision diagram or ledger identifies which data permit fitting, selecting, assessing and exploring. Demonstrate a dry-run in which assessing the target sets it unavailable for later confirmatory reuse; no biological results need be fabricated.
residual_risk: Training-only selection may be weak; without a fresh assessment any architecture comparison remains exploratory.

flaw: The factorization and smallest model do not yet define an executable scientific estimator or its observation domain.
why_it_matters: A statistical factorization can represent any distribution; it specifies neither how sparse stages constrain coefficients nor how composition/state comparisons differ without target annotations. Affine shifts in normalized expression followed by clipping do not guarantee valid normalized output or preserved covariance. Pooling assays under a conditioning label does not make their panels or capture processes comparable.
evidence: SYNTHESIS_0 Formulation names π_k, soft k, affine/low-rank shifts, p(C|X,k,...) and nonnegative normalized output but gives no estimators/losses. experts/sciml identifies unknown observation operators. agent_orchestrator.py _validate_streaming verifies finite/nonnegative matrix and gene order only, not normalization or biological calibration.
required_fix: Provide a concrete frozen baseline recipe: task-specific measured space; training-only state construction and unknown handling; per-stage weights; interpolation link for weights/means; shrinkage/rank selection; paired residual row sampling; valid output transformation with stated covariance limitations; and deterministic spatial pairing. Separate incompatible assays unless an eligible measured calibration exists. Include compute/memory bounds appropriate to panel dimensions, with T1 full-covariance estimation explicitly avoided.
verification: A reader can implement every baseline without target values. Use symbolic or small synthetic inputs to check normalization, row pairing, unseen-state handling and effects of clipping; label these as contract tests rather than biological validity.
residual_risk: State labels, capture bias, temporal curvature and absent future support remain unidentified. A concrete estimator does not establish that state/composition decomposition is biological.

flaw: Protected-target literature exposure is admitted but quarantine is only narrative, leaving downstream proposal reuse unsafe.
why_it_matters: Once reported target responses enter expert context, their influence on tissue choice, priors or model selection cannot be erased by tagging citations. This threatens a later competition-use claim even if no numerical target dataset was downloaded.
evidence: experts/causal includes Gata4 measured folding/chimera/rescue findings; debate/causal admits irreversible exposure; SYNTHESIS_0 says current run is not certified eligible. Independently inspected official rules §10 exclude held-out genotypes, comparable alleles and phenocopies: https://virtualembryo.ai/challenge/rules .
required_fix: Retain the scientific audit as exposure-unresolved and not a certified competition design. Enumerate exposed source/artifact/agent relationships and prohibit reuse of target-informed biological recommendations for competition selection. Any later competition design requires a separate clean context and provenance packet with generic findings only; do not claim that a clean packet clears the current agents or historical run. Eligibility near boundaries remains for organizer determination.
verification: A provenance/exposure register identifies affected artifacts and permitted generic abstractions. Final recommendations clearly separate research-audit knowledge from eligibility-screened inputs, and no competition eligibility verdict is inferred from expert/Jev agreement.
residual_risk: Source stage/allele audit may remain incomplete; influence is unobservable, and a clean subsequent context cannot certify historical non-use.

flaw: A plausible benchmark question is presented as a possible contribution without a closest-work novelty test.
why_it_matters: Temporal OT, mixture/state decomposition and simple-baseline perturbation benchmarking already exist. A factorial experiment on one sparse proxy could be a useful evaluation while providing neither methodological novelty nor a new scientific insight.
evidence: SYNTHESIS_0 correctly rejects ingredient novelty but suggests error attribution/benchmark as a contribution. LITERATURE_NOTES is focused and has no closest-work comparison table. Independently inspected Ahlmann-Eltze et al. primary article record supports mandatory simple baselines in its tested perturbation setting, not novelty of this proposed design: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40759747/ .
required_fix: State the present contribution as an audit and prospective falsifiable protocol. Add a bounded closest-work matrix covering forecasting, composition/state error attribution, spatial joint-vs-marginal evaluation and perturbation benchmarks, recording overlap, proposed difference and the empirical result required for novelty. Do not manufacture a literature gap when full text or a comparison is missing.
verification: Every novelty sentence maps to an explicit prior comparison and scope; inaccessible full text is recorded as unresolved. No benchmark or biological discovery is declared before data and comparison results.
residual_risk: A focused review can miss closest prior work; novelty remains unestablished even with a matrix.

flaw: Unchanged orchestration can still promote reviewer plausibility into biological belief, and the audit lacks a durable exclusion boundary.
why_it_matters: Downstream readers can consume generated ACT/LEARN outputs despite the prose disclaimer. UNPROVEN becoming falsified wrongly treats absent evidence as refutation; PLAUSIBLE becoming supported wrongly turns a critic into an experiment. Repeated updates create artificial confidence.
evidence: Independently read Neurl IPS 2026/orchestration/memory/update.py: SUSTAINED={CONFIRMED,PLAUSIBLE}, REJECTED={REJECTED,UNPROVEN}; lifecycle assignment maps these to supported/falsified; histories and calibration append without idempotence. rank.py deduplicates before pruning and skips absent gates. CODE_AUDIT acknowledges these defects. decision_layer.py labels routing/status judgments rather than scientific evidence, which is appropriate.
required_fix: Without editing original source, make audit registries the exclusive scientific decision surface and record that ACT/LEARN/rank products cannot establish biological statuses or calibration. Provide explicit hypothesis statuses: untested, supported by measured predictive evidence, contradicted by measured predictive evidence, or logically nonidentifiable under assumptions. Keep critic dispositions separate. Add a durable final-report boundary and a future repair list; reviewer confirmation of a code bug may be observed evidence, not biological support.
verification: Check every registry/final claim for a source-backed status. A hypothetical UNPROVEN verdict preserves untested rather than falsified; repeated critic reviews do not increase biological n or confidence. Do not require source repair when user scope requires preserving originals.
residual_risk: Unchanged legacy outputs remain dangerous if reused; future execution requires repairs and schema/idempotence checks.

flaw: Primary metric and spatial guardrails cannot currently be implemented with the claimed fidelity.
why_it_matters: Raw MMD is not a unique number without kernel, bandwidth, unbiased/biased estimator, sampling and preprocessing. Truth-fitted PCA is permitted evaluation but becomes target leakage if its representation guides retraining. Spatial shape, units and neighborhood computations can change rankings and blind spots.
evidence: TASK_SPECIFICATION admits unavailable scorer code, coordinate units and possible shape aggregation discrepancies. debate/stats calls the primary mmd_u, while EXPERIMENT_DESIGN says raw MMD without its contract. Actual _proxy_score uses first ≤150 rows and absent scoring module; this does not implement a versioned whole-cloud comparison.
required_fix: Create a scorer contract gate listing exact scorer/version/hash, MMD estimator/kernel/bandwidth and sampling, official vs local raw endpoints, coordinate frame/units, neighborhood reconstruction and truth-fitted evaluation-only operations. Until available, prohibit exact parity claims and numerical margins. Separate synthetic metric sensitivity/invariance tests from independent anatomical validation; report topology/absolute abundance outside score when relevant.
verification: A future eligible scorer runs copy-last and controlled row permutation, rigid frame, scale, expression-position permutation and subset tests with expected behavior recorded. No invariance, parity or biological validation is claimed merely from specification prose.
residual_risk: Even correct score replication can miss anatomy, chirality, topology, lineage and absolute abundance; metric gains remain narrower than biological validity.
